verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an official MCP server that lets assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity call the Vanta API on the user's behalf. Through it, users can query controls, surface failing tests, generate remediation plans, and act on compliance data in natural language. Vanta also markets an in-platform AI Agent that drafts policies, completes questionnaires, and flags issues. Missing for 10: a documented native natural-language command interface inside the Vanta UI (the conversational path relies on an external AI client), a clear list of which MCP actions are read versus write, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.
